welcome.title: Welcome to Polyframe
welcome.body: Sketch a screen once, then see it as a wireframe or in the style of popular UI kits. This one-minute tour shows the whole flow.

palette.title: Add components
palette.body: Drag a component onto an artboard, or click it to drop it in the middle of the view. Search works in English and Ukrainian.

canvas.title: Arrange on the canvas
canvas.body: Drag to move, use the handles to resize, drag on empty space to select several. Smart guides and the grid help you align. Hold Space and drag to pan, use ⌘ + scroll to zoom.

inspector.title: Edit in the Inspector
inspector.body: Change text, variants, size and state of the selected layer. With several layers selected you can align, distribute and group them. With nothing selected you get project and artboard settings.

layers.title: Organize layers
layers.body: The Layers tab lists every artboard and layer. Drag to reorder, double-click to rename, lock or hide what gets in the way.

mode.title: Switch the look
mode.body: Wireframe keeps you focused on structure. Styled applies a skin: shadcn/ui, MUI, Mantine, Ant Design, Bootstrap, Chakra UI, Fluent 2, Radix Themes or your own. Your layout never changes, only the look.

export.title: Export your work
export.body: Download PNG images, a JSON project file, or React code for six UI libraries. Everything is saved automatically in this browser.

share.title: Share a link
share.body: The whole project fits into the link, so nothing is uploaded. Anyone can open it in a read-only viewer and save a copy.

help.title: Work faster
help.body: Press ⌘K for the command palette and ? for all shortcuts. You can restart this tour or open the full guide from the Help menu.

guide.title: User guide
guide.description: Everything you can do in Polyframe, from the first component to code export and share links.

site.disclaimer: Polyframe is not affiliated with shadcn/ui, MUI, Mantine, Ant Design, Bootstrap or Chakra UI. Skins are visual approximations; all trademarks belong to their owners.

landing.eyebrow: Open source · No sign-up · Works offline
landing.title: Sketch it once. Wear any UI kit. Ship the code.
landing.subtitle: Drag-and-drop UI prototyping in your browser. Build a layout as a wireframe, switch it to shadcn/ui, MUI, Mantine, Ant Design, Chakra and more in one click, and export PNG, SVG or React code.
landing.privacy: Your work never leaves your browser.

demo.title: One layout, nine looks
demo.subtitle: This is the real renderer from the editor. Pick a look and the same screen changes instantly.
demo.label: Choose a look

features.title: Everything you need to sketch a screen

wireframe.title: Wireframe first
wireframe.body: Grayscale, sketchy and distraction-free. Think about structure before pixels.

skins.title: Eight skins, plus your own
skins.body: shadcn/ui, MUI, Mantine, Ant Design, Bootstrap, Chakra UI, Fluent 2 and Radix Themes. Or import your design tokens and build a custom skin.

code.title: Code for six libraries
code.body: Export a React component for shadcn/ui, MUI, Mantine, Ant Design, React Bootstrap or Chakra UI.

local.title: Local-first and private
local.body: Projects live in your browser. Share links carry the whole layout, with no server in between.

keyboard.title: Fast with the keyboard
keyboard.body: Smart guides, align, groups, undo for every gesture, and ⌘K for everything else.

templates.title: Templates to start from
templates.body: Login, dashboard, landing hero, settings, pricing and a mobile profile, in English and Ukrainian.

sketch.title: Sketch
sketch.body: Drag components onto an artboard. Snap to the grid and smart guides.

style.title: Style
style.body: Flip to Styled and try every skin to see which library fits.

ship.title: Ship
ship.body: Export PNG for the team or React code as a starting point for the build.

export.title: From canvas to code
export.body: Choose a library and a layout strategy. Absolute keeps the canvas pixel-exact, Stacked groups layers into flex rows. Every target is type-checked in CI.
export.canvasAlt: Dragging components and snapping with smart guides
export.codeAlt: Exporting a screen as React code

oss.title: Free and open source
oss.body: Polyframe is MIT licensed. Every component, skin and export target is one folder with a documented contract, so adding your own is easy.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.description: Set up Polyframe locally, learn the architecture and add components, skins or export targets.
